summary: RPM enterprise inventory: two hosts each for gateway, controller (peers=execution_nodes), hub and EDA; execution_nodes with hop1 node_type='hop' plus two exec nodes; and a [redis] group listing the six gateway, hub and EDA hosts.
questions: How do I define a hop node in the RPM inventory?
How do I configure Redis HA in the RPM enterprise inventory?
Show an RPM enterprise topology inventory

answer_card.title: RPM enterprise inventory groups
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationgateway]
gateway1.example.org
gateway2.example.org

[automationcontroller]
controller1.example.org
controller2.example.org
[automationcontroller:vars]
peers=execution_nodes

[execution_nodes]
hop1.example.org node_type='hop'
exec1.example.org
exec2.example.org

[automationhub]
hub1.example.org
hub2.example.org

[automationedacontroller]
eda1.example.org
eda2.example.org

[redis]
gateway1.example.org
gateway2.example.org
hub1.example.org
hub2.example.org
eda1.example.org
eda2.example.org
```
